nodes.label: Frontend HTML App Shell
nodes.rationale: Viewport meta deliberately omits maximum-scale/user-scalable so pinch-zoom stays available for reading dense stream tables on a phone. An inline script strips the 'dark' class on first load to avoid cached dark-mode flicker, and theme-color is pinned to the brand blue #2B589C.

nodes.label: Frontend React + TypeScript + Vite Setup
nodes.rationale: Stock Vite template notes, kept as-is. Records that the React Compiler is deliberately not enabled because of its dev/build performance cost, and documents the optional type-aware ESLint upgrade path.

nodes.label: Embedded Raster Logo/Symbol Graphic
nodes.rationale: 314x148 SVG that is only a wrapper around a base64 JPEG bitmap (714x336, Photoshop/Office export) with clip paths — not true vector artwork, so it will not scale cleanly; used as a report/branding symbol asset in backend data.

nodes.label: Sphinx Docs Toolchain
nodes.rationale: sphinx with myst-parser (Markdown authoring), sphinx-togglebutton (collapsible source blocks), sphinx-book-theme, sphinx-copybutton and sphinxcontrib-mermaid (pipeline flowcharts) — exactly the plugin set the methodology-first, toggle-block docs pattern needs.

nodes.norm_label: predictive ml cop model (scikit-learn regressor via joblib)
nodes.rationale: Trained on a heat pump manufacturer's simulation parameter study, not measurements of operating machines.

nodes.label: Custom COP Formula Evaluation (safe AST)
nodes.rationale: User formulas are compiled to an AST and validated to contain only safe math operators to prevent arbitrary code execution.

nodes.label: Heat Pump Technology Operating Windows
nodes.rationale: Hard sink-temperature and lift limits from manufacturer data define where each technology may be evaluated.

nodes.norm_label: empirical cop regressions of prototypical heat pumps

nodes.label: COP Cap of 15.0
nodes.rationale: Prevents mathematically unrealistic COP values when the temperature lift approaches zero.

nodes.label: Prototypical Heat Pump COP Regression
nodes.rationale: Empirical regressions fitted from manufacturer datasets and literature rather than theoretical thermodynamic correlations: COP = a(dT+2c)^b (T_sink+273+c)^d.

nodes.label: Carnot Archetype (half thermodynamic ceiling)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately half the Carnot ceiling, so a real refrigerant scoring above it is expected and not a physics violation.

nodes.label: Theoretical Technology Archetypes in Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Archetypes are swept through the identical mesh as trained refrigerants so published curves can be compared to real machines; COP returns -1 outside the window so the existing COP<=1 filter enforces the envelope without special-casing the loop.

nodes.label: COP Cap at 15.0
nodes.rationale: Prevents unrealistic COP as temperature lift approaches zero.

nodes.label: Temperature Pocket Deletion
nodes.rationale: Pockets are heat exchanged internally; removing them yields the pocket-free GCC showing only true external utility before heat pump integration.

nodes.label: Temperature Shifting by ΔTmin/2
nodes.rationale: After shifting, equal shifted temperatures mean actual temperatures are exactly ΔTmin apart, guaranteeing feasible exchange without pairwise checks.

nodes.label: Physical Lift from Shifted GCC Temperatures
nodes.norm_label: physical lift from shifted gcc temperatures
nodes.rationale: Opposite dTmin/2 shifts make T_sink - T_source equal the true physical lift, so no extra dTmin penalty is applied in COP.

nodes.label: Temperature Shifting by dTmin/2
nodes.rationale: After shifting, hot and cold streams at the same shifted temperature are exactly dTmin apart, guaranteeing feasible exchange without pairwise checks.

nodes.label: Multi-Stage Heat Pump Designs (1/2/3 stage)
nodes.rationale: Each fluid is tabulated at one, two and three stages; extra stages mainly raise the achievable COP_max at the same temperature envelope rather than widening the envelope, and steam sink media carry higher COP_min but narrower ranges than water.

nodes.label: HeatTransPlan
nodes.rationale: Finds how much heat can be exchanged internally instead of bought twice (boiler and chiller), and what a heat pump could do with the rest.

nodes.label: Four-Stage Workflow (data collection, stream selection, pinch analysis, heat pump integration)

nodes.label: Heat Pump Integration — Classic Method (HTML page)
nodes.norm_label: heat pump integration — classic method (html page)

nodes.label: Geographic Stream Placement and Distance Matrix
nodes.norm_label: geographic stream placement and distance matrix
nodes.rationale: Streams are placed on a real map because a thermodynamically ideal match may be far away; the distance matrix lets matches be checked against connection cost.

nodes.label: Thermodynamic Potential, Not a Design
nodes.rationale: Analysis assumes heat can be exchanged wherever temperatures allow; does not cost pipework, check simultaneity or size equipment — it tells whether a detailed study is worth commissioning.

nodes.label: Live Sessions / Connect AI
nodes.rationale: Page keeps its project on the backend, reports its view, and executes commands with the same functions as its own buttons, via server-sent events.

nodes.label: Requests-per-Visitor Rate Limit (rate_limit.py)
nodes.rationale: Prevents flooding and brute-forcing Connect AI codes (30 wrong codes in 10 minutes blocks the visitor).

nodes.label: Single-Process In-Memory State Limitation
nodes.rationale: Limits, sessions and download links live in backend memory: fine for one server, would need a shared store such as Redis for several.

nodes.label: Economic Heat Pump Size Chart
nodes.rationale: Source- and demand-limited pumps excluded so a poor-COP partial pump in an empty duty step does not pull the curve to a loss.

nodes.label: Reference System (gas/oil/electric boiler + cooling)
nodes.rationale: Reference supplies the largest demand any candidate could cover so small and large pumps are compared against the same current situation; HP credited only with what it replaces.

nodes.label: Demand-Limited Heat Pump Integration
nodes.rationale: Both limited cases drawn hollow and excluded from the COP-vs-coverage frontier so a capped machine does not put a dip in the curve.

nodes.label: Maximum-Duty Point Selection with COP Tie-break
nodes.norm_label: maximum-duty point selection with cop tie-break
nodes.rationale: Many machines tie at the top duty; plain > left the winner to iteration order, so ties are broken by COP at the API level.

nodes.label: Break-even Electricity Price (break_even_el_price)
nodes.rationale: NPV is linear in electricity price, so two evaluations give the exact root.

nodes.label: Dynamic Payback
nodes.rationale: Searches up to 40 years past T; residual value excluded since it is not cash in hand before period end.

nodes.label: Five-Stage Workflow (data collection, stream selection, pinch, HP integration, economics)
nodes.norm_label: five-stage workflow (data collection, stream selection, pinch, hp integration, economics)

nodes.label: Gross vs Net Calorific Value (Hs/Hi) Correction
nodes.norm_label: gross vs net calorific value (hs/hi) correction
nodes.rationale: Gas billed on Hs but CO2 factor on Hi; using one efficiency overstates gas CO2 by about 11%.

nodes.label: Net Present Value Method (Kapitalwertmethode)
nodes.rationale: Price-dynamic cash flows per VDI 2067-1; annuity method of VDI 4646 gives the same decision (annuity = NPV x annuity factor).

nodes.label: Price Escalation (+3%/year default)
nodes.rationale: Deliberate deviation from VDI 4646 constant prices, permitted by VDI 2067 §6.9; same rate on both keeps electricity-to-gas ratio constant.

nodes.label: compile_formula (safe AST custom COP formula)
nodes.rationale: Custom expressions compiled into an AST and validated to safe math operators to prevent arbitrary code execution.

nodes.label: Project Data Retention (deleted at Disconnect or after 24h)
nodes.norm_label: project data retention (deleted at disconnect or after 24h)

nodes.label: COP Training Module (Train from my data)
nodes.norm_label: cop training module (train from my data)
nodes.rationale: Model stored as plain numbers and evaluated directly so the backend never loads code sent by the page; offered only inside the training data range to avoid extrapolation; capped at 10,000 rows for speed.

nodes.label: Backend Environment Variables (API_KEYS, AI_ENABLED, RATE_LIMIT, PROJECT_RETENTION_HOURS, COP_TRAINING_ENABLED)
nodes.norm_label: backend environment variables (api_keys, ai_enabled, rate_limit, project_retention_hours, cop_training_enabled)

nodes.label: Economic Validation (VDI examples, Hipp study)
nodes.rationale: Reproduces norm worked examples and study tables; study's Max. WRG NPV is inconsistent and the app uses the consistent formula. Runs as backend/tests/test_economics.py.

nodes.label: Geographic Dimension (map placement, distance matrix)
nodes.rationale: A thermodynamically ideal match may be half a kilometre away, so streams live on a real map and distances are exported.

nodes.label: Thermodynamic Potential, Not a Design (screening scope)
nodes.norm_label: thermodynamic potential, not a design (screening scope)
nodes.rationale: Analysis ignores pipework cost, timing coincidence and equipment sizing; it tells whether a detailed study is worth commissioning.

nodes.label: Project MCP Tools (add_process, add_stream, replace_project, ...)
nodes.rationale: Edits follow the page's own rules: new process gets one subprocess, deletes renumber indices and stream selection.

nodes.label: HeatTransPlan MCP Server (Streamable HTTP at /mcp)
nodes.rationale: Served by the backend at /mcp so any remote-MCP agent connects by URL with nothing to install; stdio mode exists for local file access by path.

nodes.label: Only on the Open Page, Under User Control (pause, activity log, confirmations)
nodes.norm_label: only on the open page, under user control (pause, activity log, confirmations)

nodes.label: What the AI May Do (rules and enforcement)
nodes.norm_label: what the ai may do (rules and enforcement)
nodes.rationale: Agents act only on a connected page, can be paused (423), must ask before destructive actions, are logged, mark their reports, treat document text as data not instructions, and never touch server files.

nodes.label: econReportData (shared econ module)
nodes.rationale: Panel, comparison and report built from one module so they always show the same numbers.

nodes.label: Theoretical Technology Archetypes (Stirling, VHTHP, SHP/HTHP, 50% Carnot)
nodes.norm_label: theoretical technology archetypes (stirling, vhthp, shp/hthp, 50% carnot)
nodes.rationale: Swept through the identical mesh as trained refrigerants so published curves compare directly; COP callable returns -1 outside the rated window so the existing COP<=1 filter enforces the envelope for free.

nodes.label: HeatTransPlan Web Application
nodes.rationale: Collects industrial process energy data and analyses heat recovery and heat pump integration via pinch analysis; developed in the HeatTransPlan research project at University of Paderborn.

nodes.label: Tech Stack (React/Vite, FastAPI, scikit-learn, Leaflet, Plotly, Caddy, Docker)
nodes.norm_label: tech stack (react/vite, fastapi, scikit-learn, leaflet, plotly, caddy, docker)

nodes.label: Weekly Dependabot Updates (pip, npm, docker, github-actions)
nodes.norm_label: weekly dependabot updates (pip, npm, docker, github-actions)
nodes.rationale: Weekly checks for updates with known security fixes, one pull request each; covers backend, mcp_server, docs (pip), frontend (npm), Dockerfiles and GitHub Actions.

nodes.label: backend service (container)
nodes.rationale: Built from repo root so the image carries mcp_server/ and docs/; mounts only ./models read-only so modelling data stays off the server.

nodes.label: Caddy reverse proxy service
nodes.rationale: Only public entry point; SITE_ADDRESS from .env enables HTTPS certificates, unset serves plain http on :80.

nodes.label: frontend service (container)
nodes.rationale: VITE_API_BASE is a build arg because Vite bakes VITE_* into the bundle; empty means same-origin /api routed by Caddy.

nodes.label: Container Hardening (read_only, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges)
nodes.rationale: Read-only filesystem except tmpfs, no capabilities beyond NET_BIND_SERVICE, cannot gain privileges, so a library flaw cannot take over the machine.

nodes.label: Security Layers (no login, each layer holds on its own)
nodes.norm_label: security layers (no login, each layer holds on its own)
nodes.rationale: App is public with no accounts, so rate limits, upload size cap, browser headers, text-not-markup reports, data retention, hardened containers, dependency updates and unlistable sessions each must hold independently.

nodes.label: COP Neural Network Models (MLPRegressor 128-64, 4T and 2T)
nodes.rationale: 4-temperature model (MAE 0.06, R2 0.990) is standard; 2-temperature model cannot see source cool-down or sink heat-up, kept for comparison. Trained on 3468 simulated points from a manufacturer parameter study.

nodes.label: Allocation Factor (Finnish method)
nodes.rationale: Extension of VDI 4646: cooling term multiplied by actively cooled share a; cold that replaces no chiller earns no credit.

nodes.label: VDI 4646 Results (LCOH, static payback, IRR)
nodes.rationale: IRR replaced ROI because ROI's definition was an assumption while IRR is the norm's.

nodes.label: Danish Energy Agency Technology Data - Industrial Process Heat (2026)
nodes.norm_label: danish energy agency technology data - industrial process heat (2026)

nodes.label: Heat Pump Investment (flat 1000 EUR/kW x F_PI x F_Per)
nodes.norm_label: heat pump investment (flat 1000 eur/kw x f_pi x f_per)
nodes.rationale: Deviation from VDI 4646: flat machine price from manufacturer offers and integration factor 1.25 instead of 1.8, because VDI factors fit cheap machines and would overstate installed cost for high-temperature pumps; economies of scale not modelled.
